_: Reclaim's voice, keyed screen.element. This is the primary brand asset — it is the bundled fallback, and the Supabase copy table overrides it so the voice can change without an App Store release. Every line here was written against the three rules in BRIEF.md: zero setup, the Caregiver voice test, and the knowledge test (what does the app actually know, and when did it learn it). Never show what was missed. Never compare people. Never name someone who hasn't acted.
welcome.headline: Set your phone down. We'll take it from here.
welcome.body: No blocking, no lectures. Just a quiet count of the hours you spend away from it, and who you spent them with.
welcome.footer: For the people in the room, not the ones in your pocket.
home.headline: Ready when you are.
home.body: Set your phone down and we'll start counting. Where you are is optional.
home.suggestion.title: Start it at {place}
home.suggestion.body: Most evenings this week, that's where you were.
home.suggestion.note: A guess from your history, not from your location. You can also name the place afterwards, or leave it unnamed.
dayone.headline: Nothing here yet.
dayone.body: Which is the right amount for a first evening. There's nothing to set up — put your phone down and we'll start from there.
dayone.invite.title: It's better with someone else in it.
dayone.invite.body: When a friend has Reclaim too, you'll see when they've set theirs down, and you can sit it out together.
dayone.footer: No streak, no score, no setup. Those arrive on their own.
docked.headline: Docked. See you in a bit.
docked.body: It's already counting. Everything below can wait until you pick this up again.
docked.where.label: Where
docked.where.body: If there's a card on the table, scan it and this becomes that place. If there isn't, it stays Somewhere — which counts exactly the same.
docked.footer: Or name it later, when the evening's over.
join.headline: {name} set hers down at {place}.
join.body: Two phones down so far. {names} and you are still holding yours.
countup.headline: Turn your phone over.
countup.body: The count only goes up. Anyone can join whenever they get here.
countup.footer: Nobody gets named for holding onto theirs.
session.line: Docked. See you in a bit.
lockscreen.note: Ending the session never asks you to unlock.
starttap.banner.title: Docked at {place}
starttap.note: Tapped the card on the way in. The screen never unlocked, and the app never opened.
end.headline: {duration} reclaimed.
end.rhythm: That's {count} evenings this week. A rhythm, more or less.
place.stage.label: This place is
place.stage.next: Landmarks start at fifty evenings. No hurry — a place only ever moves forward.
place.card.body: The card for this place. How anyone new joins an evening here.
rhythm.headline: You're in a rhythm.
rhythm.longest: Your longest ran {count} days, back in {month}.
rhythm.rest.title: One rest day in hand.
rhythm.rest.body: Miss a day and we'll spend it for you. Miss more and you're simply between rhythms — one evening puts you back in.
rhythm.privacy: Only you see this. The people you dock with see that you were there, never how often you weren't.
autoclosed.headline: We closed this one for you.
autoclosed.body: You set your phone down at {time} and we never heard from you again. We've counted two hours and stopped there rather than guess.
autoclosed.counts: It still counts toward last night.
autoclosed.remove: That wasn't a real one — remove it
rhythmended.headline: That rhythm ended.
rhythmended.body: {count} days happened. Nothing about them changed — they're still {count} days. You're between rhythms now, and one evening starts the next.
rhythmended.footer: Your rest day comes back on Sunday.
countthat.headline: You were away for {duration}.
countthat.body: Your phone sat untouched from {time}. We don't know what you were up to — you tell us.
countthat.decline: No, I was on my laptop
countthat.footer: You never have to start one of these. We'll keep asking afterwards.
card.instruction: Tap your phone here, or scan the code. Then set it down.
settings.title: Settings
settings.nudge.title: One nudge an evening
settings.how.label: How it works
settings.how.1: An evening counts once you've been away fifteen minutes.
settings.how.2: If you forget to end one, we close it at three hours and count it there.
settings.how.3: Your rest day comes back every Sunday.
settings.see.label: What we can see
settings.see.body: When you set your phone down, and who was there with you. Nothing about your screen, the apps you opened, or where you were.
places.title: Places
places.live.label: Happening now
places.somewhere.title: Somewhere
places.somewhere.body: {count} evenings, somewhere. They count the same.
places.merge: Two of these really the same place? Merge them.
places.scan: Scan a card to join a new one
naming.headline: What should we call it?
naming.context: {count} evenings here so far, all of them around {time}.
naming.label: Name
naming.suggestions.label: Or take one of these.
naming.footer: You can change this whenever. The card is {handle} either way, and it keeps working.
onetap.headline: Want this to be one tap?
onetap.step.1: You tap the card by the door.
onetap.step.3: Your phone goes quiet, using your own Focus.
onetap.body: It's a Shortcut, built by Apple's app rather than ours. We hand you the finished thing — you tap Add once and never think about it again.
onetap.footer: Everything works exactly the same without it. We won't ask again.
